repair_2026-10-26.evidence: REPAIRED 2026-10-26 (JOB ONSET-REPAIR-1). The defect: PLAN phrase-1 window opened at 1.95 s while the first word's spoken onset (its PLAN word start) is 1.42 s — +530 ms (measured by JOB PACKAGE-VERIFY-3's playback probe; this job's baseline probe of the unmodified scene, same method, first saw word 1 "Mainz," at audioT 1.971 s). The change, confined to the opening timing (byte-exact reconstruction check: the repaired scene differs from the branch master by exactly these two values and nothing else): (1) PLAN phrases[0].start 1.9500000000000002 -> 1.42 — the phrase-1 window now opens at the first word's spoken onset; the word's own start (1.42 s) already equalled its onset and did not move; (2) the render loop's opening-card gate `if (t < 1.6)` -> `if (t < 1.42)` — the gate is the early return that suppresses ALL phrase rendering while the opening card holds, so at 1.6 s it would have kept word 1 invisible until 1.6 s (+180 ms residual); it is the phrase-1 window's outer gate and moved with it. PLAN timeline[0][0] deliberately NOT moved (1.95 s): it drives line-1 progress, plate zoom and label predicates for the whole line, and lineAt() already returns line 0 before it; the offset was a phrase-window defect, not a line-window one. Words 2+ carry independent starts and were not touched. Re-probe of the repaired scene (same probe, private port): word 1 first visible at audioT 1.501 s — residual +81 ms against the 1.42 s onset, within the probe's own precision (150 ms poll step; the verify jobs' first-visible readings scatter +21..+188 ms around known onsets, and words 2-4 re-probed unchanged within the same scatter); zero page exceptions. The candidate render was re-rendered from the repaired scene with the house capture (renderAt at 30 fps, libx264 CRF 19 — the delivered encode) and the package's verified clone programme audio stream copied byte-identical (sha256 of the stream equals audio/narration.m4a): new render sha256 373ddae0272d96387d65c56ccc1c917ecd87b9dd5df1e0f2ee2e7e828b480738, 16587243 B, duration 54.92 s, 1647 frames, measured -14.53 LUFS / -1.35 dBTP (delivered candidate: 54.92 s, -14.53 LUFS / -1.35 dBTP).
